work.title: The Baptist Confession of Faith of 1689
work.license_basis: CrossWire module metadata declares DistributionLicense=Public Domain; the underlying historical confession is public domain by age.

revision.attribution: The Baptist Confession of Faith of 1689. Based on the public-domain CrossWire BaptistConfession1689 1.0.2 module, obtained from reformed.org with thanks to Ed Walsh. Obvious transcription omissions, Scripture-reference errors, and markup defects were corrected against the historical 1677 text. No doctrinal or stylistic modernization was intended. Editorial changes are recorded in the source info manifest.
editorial_policy: Retain the CrossWire module's existing modernized spelling and punctuation.
Restore words demonstrably omitted or corrupted when compared with the historical text.
Correct displayed Scripture proofs and OSIS targets when the historical proof or the displayed reference makes the intended target unambiguous.
Retain valid later editorial proof additions and documented corrections of apparent errors in the historical printing.
Keep the original CrossWire export unchanged and generate this revision reproducibly from it.

verification_sources.description: Scan of an original 1677 printing, used for direct spot checks of text and marginal Scripture proofs.
Near-facsimile electronic transcription made from a microfilm copy of an original 1677 Confession, used for the systematic comparison.
CrossWire module metadata and public-domain distribution declaration.
